| `content` | `union` |          | `\{\}`  | Persisted configuration blob. Start card keys (abstract-start-card): `layout: "start"` draws `title` and `description` beside the control, and `link` (`{ label, route? \| href? }`) after it. `objectSource` (`{ register, schema, labelField?, placeholder?, ariaLabel?, preload? }`) makes the control an OpenRegister object picker that searches on the server and writes the picked object's id; without a selection and without `allLabel` it selects the first object. Chips (screens-page-lenses): `style: "chips"` draws the options as one compact segmented group with a count after each label. An option's `countFrom` (`{ register, schema, filter? }`, or a list of them that are added up) counts that list; a static `count` is used otherwise. `urlKey` keeps the choice in the address (`?&lt;urlKey&gt;=&lt;value&gt;`), and the address wins over `default` on load. Page controls (screens-page-controls): `style: "toggle"` is a switch that writes `onValue` / `offValue` (true / false); `layout: "bar"` with `controls` draws several controls side by side in one row, and `align: "end"` pushes a control to the right edge. Input (workspace-filter-input): `style: "input"` draws a labelled text field and a load button (`submitLabel`). The value is written only when it is loaded and only when valid: `inputType: "quarter"` reads `YYYY-Qn` and `"year"` reads `YYYY`, both seeded with the current one; any other input takes a `pattern` (a regular expression) if given. `exportTable: { exportId, label? }` adds a button beside the load button that asks the object table with that `exportId` for its rows as CSV (DqTermijnen "CSV exporteren"). |
